# MM Transports

> Container truck transport company based on Willingdon Island, Kochi, Kerala,
> India. Founded 1997. Runs a fleet of 15 container trucks across Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka
> and Andhra Pradesh, specialising in container haulage, including movement to and from the Kochi container terminals.

## Key facts

- **Legal/trading name:** MM Transports
- **Founded:** 1997, by Manoharan Nagarajan
- **Managing Director:** Manoharan Nagarajan
- **General Manager:** M Vishnu Prasad
- **Address:** CDEA Building, Indira Gandhi Road, opposite Fire Station, Willingdon Island, Kochi, Kerala 682003, India
- **Phone / WhatsApp:** +91 96336 65648
- **Email:** operations@mmtransports.in
- **Working hours:** Monday to Saturday, 9:00 am to 6:30 pm
- **Fleet:** 15 container transport trucks, currently expanding
- **Registration:** GST registered
- **Areas served:** Kerala (all districts), Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh

## What MM Transports specialises in

Container haulage and nothing else — no part-loads, no parcels, no cold chain. Every vehicle in
the fleet is a container truck. The company has worked this single trade continuously since 1997.
The office and yard are on Willingdon Island, Kochi, close to the Vallarpadam container terminal.

## Services

- **Container Transport** — enclosed container trucks for packaged, palletised and containerised cargo; sealed at pickup, opened at delivery.
- **Port Container Movement** — container shifting to and from the Kochi container terminals, including Vallarpadam.
- **Factory & Industrial Goods Transport** — raw materials inbound and finished goods outbound on fixed schedules for manufacturers.
- **Interstate Long Distance Transport** — Kerala to Tamil Nadu, Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh.
- **Regular Contract Movement** — dedicated trucks on a recurring weekly or monthly schedule at rates fixed in advance.

## Frequently asked questions

**What kind of trucks does MM Transports operate?**
A fleet of 15 container transport trucks. Every vehicle in the fleet is a container truck — the
company does not run part-loads, parcels or cold chain. The fleet is being expanded.

**Where is MM Transports located?**
CDEA Building, Indira Gandhi Road, opposite the Fire Station, Willingdon Island, Kochi, Kerala
682003.

**Which areas does MM Transports cover?**
Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Karnataka and Andhra Pradesh.

**Does MM Transports handle container movement to and from the Kochi terminals?**
Yes. Container shifting to and from the terminals, including Vallarpadam, is part of the work. The office is on Willingdon Island, Kochi.

**How long has MM Transports been in business?**
Since 1997 — close to thirty years of continuous operation.

**Is MM Transports GST registered?**
Yes, with full consignment documentation issued on every load.

**How do I get a quote?**
Call or WhatsApp +91 96336 65648, or use the contact form at https://mmtransports.in/contact.html.
Quotes are returned the same working day.
